name: Joybound People & Pets - Spay/Neuter Clinic
fullDescription: Joybound's spay and neuter clinic in Walnut Creek, plus its mobile clinic, offers low-cost spay and neuter surgery for community dogs and cats of Contra Costa County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Low-cost spay and neuter surgeries for dogs and cats
- Open to Contra Costa County residents
- Free microchip, plus age-appropriate vaccines and post-surgery pain medication
- Mobile spay/neuter clinic visits several times a month
- Pet Safety Net may help qualifying residents with the cost
howToGetIt:
1. Call the Joybound spay/neuter clinic at 925-296-3125 to schedule
2. Pay the required non-refundable deposit
3. Follow pre-surgery instructions
4. Bring pet to scheduled appointment
5. Pay the remaining fee at time of service
keywords: Joybound, spay, neuter, low-cost, Contra Costa, Walnut Creek, mobile clinic, dog surgery, cat surgery, fix pet, sterilization
